description.en: Full-page layouts, hero sections, and interactive headers built with Tailwind.
description.zh: 涵盖整页排版、交互式导航与 Hero 区块的高质量 Tailwind 布局库。

content.en: UI Layouts by Naymur Rahman offers full-page layout patterns, creative hero headers, and animated component compositions crafted with React and Tailwind CSS. It serves as an open layout recipe book for developers seeking contemporary structure ideas.
content.zh: UI Layouts 是由 Naymur Rahman 发起维护的整页布局方案与动效交互合集。依托 React 与 Tailwind CSS，它提供了大量富有表现力的全屏落地页模板、粘性滚动导航与创意排版构图，是探索新颖页面结构的实用灵感库。
